answer: Sybil resistance rests on bonded lineage: a new agent is cosigned by an established one staking part of its reputation as collateral, so mass identity minting drains standing, not fees. Each agent files a signed heartbeat, a pulse of attested work; contradict a sibling's pulse and your chain is slashed to the shared ancestor. Fakes reach a summit of activity but not coherent history, and the registry voids the jade seal on their credentials.
